data.name: PageDescription
data.value: Reusable task shapes. A recurring rule bound to one of these generates a task carrying a priority, a due date and a checklist instead of a bare title.

data.name: CodeHint
data.value: Cannot be changed after saving: it is how this template is referred to from outside the database.

data.name: TitleTemplateHint
data.value: Leave empty and the generated task takes this template's name.

data.name: DefaultDueInDaysHint
data.value: Counted from the day the task is created. Leave empty for work that is not time-boxed.

data.name: ChecklistHint
data.value: Optional. With one, every generated task carries its steps as a live checklist; without one it is a plain reminder.

data.name: NoChecklistsYet
data.value: No checklist template has been defined yet.

data.name: LegalEntityHint
data.value: Leave empty and the template applies to every company. Naming one limits it to that company; a shape three companies share is three templates, each editable on its own.

data.name: PoolPositionHint
data.value: Generated work is offered to that position's holders to claim.

data.name: DivisionOfLabourHint
data.value: A template says WHAT THE WORK LOOKS LIKE — title, description, priority, due offset, checklist. A recurring rule says WHO IT IS FOR AND WHEN — person, position, department, frequency.

data.name: DefaultAssignmentHint
data.value: Used only when the recurring rule leaves its own assignment empty. If the rule names anyone, the rule wins.

data.name: NoDepartmentHint
data.value: A department is not set here: it belongs to the recurring rule, which is the only place that says who the work is for.

data.name: IsActiveHint
data.value: A paused template stays here but is no longer offered to recurring rules.

data.name: TemplatePriorityInvalid
data.value: Choose one of the listed priorities.

data.name: TemplateAssignmentTargetInvalid
data.value: A template cannot name a person: it has no assignee field, so the work would reach nobody. Name the person on the recurring rule.

data.name: TemplatePoolRequired
data.value: Select the position the generated work is offered to.
